label: 万人跪拜之城
meaning: Citizens kneel synchronously as Leia passes through Astaria inner city; bread, water and medical care genuinely function. Leia is concerned, un-crowned and at street level. The image holds obedience and material safety together rather than converting the scene into a generic tyrant/coronation picture.
timing: After the alliance has entered the inner city and before street control is released. This is not the subsequent bread-queue argument, hospital-line separation, coronation or concluding council.
identities: Leia matches approved char-leia-03, the canonical 27-year-old alliance commander: brown braid, white forelock, cheek scar, slate patched cloak and practical bracer. Other townspeople and medical staff are unnamed; the bread carrier is not asserted to be Marta or the doctor to be Ada.
visualConcretization: Large pale-stone capital forms, clean street, working fountain, stocked bread shelves, lit beds and orderly kneeling residents express the prose. No new heraldic banners remain in the selected version. Exact architecture is a coherent setting illustration, not a claim to a map model.
